verdict_reason: NICFI Asia needs a NICFI Planet account sign-up before it works in GEE (non-commercial, purpose-bound licence); the forest-edge-encroachment framing is inside NICFI's purpose, but its 30.2N bbox cap leaves northern India uncovered. Sentinel-1/2, Hansen GFC and OSM are all open, no application. Ground truth must be constructed from Hansen+OSM+Sentinel overlay; RADD does not cover India.

sources.name: Sentinel-1 GRD (COPERNICUS/S1_GRD)
sources.licence_quote: The use of Sentinel data is governed by the Copernicus Sentinel Data Terms and Conditions.

sources.name: Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED)
sources.licence_quote: The use of Sentinel data is governed by the Copernicus Sentinel Data Terms and Conditions.
sources.coverage_quote: March 28, 2017 to September 12, 2026; global coverage from January 25, 2022 onward
caveats_quoted: earlier periods have limited geographic extent

sources.name: NICFI Satellite Data Program Basemaps - Asia (Planet/Norway, via GEE)
sources.licence_quote: the primary purpose of reducing and reversing the loss of tropical forests, contributing to combating climate change, conserving biodiversity
caveats_quoted: coverage bound of 30.2N excludes the northern Himalayan belt of India from the Asia basemap extent
requires creating and logging into a NICFI Planet account before Basemaps can be enabled in GEE Account Settings

sources.name: Hansen Global Forest Change v1.11 (UMD)
caveats_quoted: annual product, not real-time; 30.92 m resolution is coarser than plot-level boundaries

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (plot/cadastral boundary proxy)
sources.licence_quote: You are free to copy, distribute, transmit and adapt our data, as long as you credit OpenStreetMap and its contributors.
sources.coverage_quote: global, contributor-mapped, Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL)
caveats_quoted: parcel/land-use mapping density in rural Indian forest-edge areas is sparse and inconsistent

sources.name: RADD Forest Disturbance Alert (WUR/GFW)
sources.licence_quote: licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License and may be used by anyone, anywhere, anytime
sources.coverage_quote: Primary humid tropical forest of South America (13 countries), Central America (6 countries), Africa (25 countries), insular Southeast Asia (5 countries) and Pacific (1 country)
caveats_quoted: India and South Asia are not part of RADD's covered country list, so it cannot be used as the encroachment-alert engine for this candidate

ground_truth.construction_protocol: Overlay Hansen forest-loss polygons with OSM/land-record plot boundaries on Sentinel-1/2 time series at forest edges; analyst labels each plot-year encroaching/stable, direction from loss-polygon centroid shift; sample ~200 plots.

compute_path.platform: Google Earth Engine (cloud) for S1/S2/NICFI/Hansen compositing and overlay; optional lightweight classifier on Colab free tier
compute_path.why: All imagery fusion and change detection runs server-side in GEE, no local GPU; a small CNN/RF for direction classification trains within Colab's free-tier hours
